trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: Earn all other 54 trophies to unlock the platinum. This is the final trophy you obtain after completing everything else.

trophies.name: Fair Game - Specific
trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion by finishing all activities: 8 bank vaults, 39 gang operations, 42 shooting range golds, 42 drone races, 15 target decks, 100 optional missions, 277 vehicle scans, 255 animal studies, 18 meditations, 80 challenges, 397 stunts.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission (No Better Place Than This). Unlocks the 100% Completion checklist in free-roam. This is one of the hidden gold trophies.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete any 3 Collectible Card sets (tracked under Progress > Collections, such as Vice City Flamingos, Liberty City Swingers, Ed Comics Universe, etc.).

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Scan any 100 points of interest with the WAiNK phone app across the 31 Landmarks, 35 Curiosities, 23 Sculptures, and No Flusher tags.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Unlocked in Chapter 4 via the optional mission That's Where The Money Is… Tail a security van to a large bank, enter the open vault, hand a bag of cash to your partner (hold R1/RB), and escape the 4-star police response on a fast motorcycle. All 8 vaults are needed for 100%.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.official: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Unlocks automatically when robbing your first Bank Vault, or by blocking an armored truck on the street, blowing its rear doors with a Sticky Bomb, and escaping the red heat radius.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Completely clear the black fog across the entire map of Leonida. Flying a plane over dark coastal and swamp patches is the fastest way to uncover the map.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.official: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt the unique animal for Bret tracked under Progress > Gangs. Part of the 9 gang operations to complete.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete any 250 of the 397 stunts across 4 categories: 130 Stunt Jumps, 202 Under the Bridges, 40 Knife Flights, and 25 Base Jumps. Push to 300 for the 100% checklist.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.official: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try all 9 activity types at least once: Fishing, Hunting, Golf, Shooting Ranges, Pool, Basketball (sink a hoop), Arcade Video Game, winning a Race, and performing a Stunt.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.official: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn all 42 gold medals across the 12 Shooting Ranges in Leonida. Also levels up your Focus stat toward Level 4.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.official: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win at least one Top Fun drone race at each of the 14 locations (complete all 3 races at each spot, 42 total, for 100% completion).

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races out of the 40 unique race events available on the map.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.official: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: After meeting Cal in the Chapter 1 mission Feng Shui, follow his purple map markers sent via text message and beat him in his fishing challenge.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Finish all levels of any 1 of the 4 video games: Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III, Time Jackers Rewind, or Bang For Your Buck on arcade cabinets.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.official: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Reach 18 on the Meditation counter. Meditating together with both Jason and Lucia counts twice (+2). Do not skip Lucia's balcony meditation after Down to Earth in Chapter 1 - this is the potentially missable spot.

trophies.name: Fair Game: Specific
trophies.official: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt the unique animal for Bret tracked under Progress > Gangs. Part of the 9 gang operations to complete.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.official: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Call your partner (hold Right on D-pad, then Triangle/Y after Chapter 2's Coffee Break), trigger a 4-star Wanted Level, and escape the red heat zone. Do this with your partner accompanying you.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.official: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner accompanying you, rob 3 shops in a row while keeping your active Wanted Level flashing. The 3 closely grouped jewelry stores in north Vice City after Chapter 3 work great.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Scan 100 different vehicle models in traffic using the WAiNK phone app. You do not need to enter or drive them.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.official: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: With Focus at Level 4 and an Adrenaline boost, click L3 + R3/LS + RS while aiming an assault rifle at a crowded Gang Operation and eliminate 5 gang members in one activation.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.official: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: After unlocking the silent Snap Gun lockpick in Chapter 3's Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs, pick the locked backdoor of a jewelry store, read the safe code note in the backroom, and loot the safe undetected.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.official: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: After obtaining the Dye Pack Jammer in Chapter 3's Credit Check (Meet Raul's Crew), launder a cumulative $250,000 of Marked Bills from bank and Payday Loan robberies through fences. Yasmani in Vice City pays the highest rate.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend a cumulative total of $100,000 across Ammu-Nation gun stores, car mod shops, clothing boutiques, and tattoo parlors.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Buy all 8 purchasable garages on the Vice City Real Estate phone app (unlocked after Daily Driver in Chapter 2) for roughly $160,000 total.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.official: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 stolen vehicles to the Scooter Bros app at Moses' garage in Port Gellhorn (Chapter 2) or at any Pay 'n' Spray from Chapter 3 onward. Use inexpensive bikes or compact cars to keep registration fees low.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Finish the opening mission, Gone Fishing. This is one of the hidden trophies - its name and description are hidden until earned.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 1. This is one of the hidden trophies - its name and description are hidden until earned.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 2. This is one of the hidden trophies - its name and description are hidden until earned. Note: name contains asterisks as published by PlayStation.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 3. This is one of the hidden trophies - its name and description are hidden until earned.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 4. This is one of the hidden trophies - its name and description are hidden until earned.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete the Chapter 2 main mission Breakfast Run (Check on Jason). This is one of the hidden trophies.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Complete the major Chapter 3 heist mission The Cartel Heist. This is one of the hidden trophies.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete the Chapter 4 main mission Child's Play. This is one of the hidden trophies.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete the Chapter 4 main mission Headliners. This is one of the hidden trophies.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete the Chapter 4 airport mission VCIA Takedown. This is one of the hidden trophies.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Complete the Chapter 5 main mission Operation Savage Glory. This is one of the hidden trophies.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.official: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete Andy's last mission. This is one of the hidden trophies.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.official: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete Kenton's last mission. This is one of the hidden trophies.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.official: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete Billy's last mission. This is one of the hidden trophies.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.official: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete Randy's last mission. This is one of the hidden trophies.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.official: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete Tyrone's last mission. This is one of the hidden trophies.

trophies.name: Map Explorer
trophies.guide: Scan all 31 Landmarks, 35 Curiosities, 23 Sculptures, and collect all No Flusher tags across Leonida's map.

trophies.name: Package Delivery
trophies.guide: Complete 20 of the package delivery missions available via the in-game phone.

trophies.name: Vehicle Collector
trophies.guide: Store 50 different vehicles in your purchased garages across Leonida.

trophies.name: Photo Mode
trophies.guide: Use the photo mode to take 50 pictures of scenery, vehicles, or animals across Leonida.

trophies.name: Style Icon
trophies.guide: Buy and equip 20 different outfits from clothing boutiques across Leonida.

trophies.name: Tattoo Artist
trophies.guide: Visit tattoo parlors and get 10 different tattoos.

trophies.name: Gym Rat
trophies.guide: Complete 100 workout sessions at gyms across Leonida to boost strength and stamina.

trophies.name: Street Racer
trophies.guide: Win 50 street races across the free-roam mode.

trophies.name: Flying Ace
trophies.guide: Complete 20 aircraft flight missions across Leonida.

trophies.name: Diver
trophies.guide: Complete 15 underwater diving missions and collect underwater items.

trophies.name: Treasure Hunter
trophies.guide: Find and collect 50 hidden packages scattered across Leonida's map.

trophies.name: Park Perfection
trophies.guide: Successfully perform perfect parallel parking 50 times across Leonida.
